title: Prehistoric Potion Adventures
summary: Seeker, Jane, and a colorful crowd of Frasgles drink a magical potion crafted by Isabella to travel back to the prehistoric world. Along their journey, they encounter a terrifying T-Rex, who they scare away with loud noises, and meet a giant tea-loving sloth who invites them to its burrow. They also cross paths with a woolly mammoth and a fierce smilodon that turns out to just want belly rubs. After returning to Seeker's castle, Jane discovers a tiny shrew-like prehistoric creature hitching a ride in her jacket pocket. Isabella welcomes the creature into her dollhouse, feeding it bugs and telling it bedtime stories.

transcript.text: Who is it said Seeker?

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: It is Jane.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And Seeker said, 'Oh, hello Jane.'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Um, I did some fossil digging.

transcript.speaker: Dad

transcript.speaker: Izzy

transcript.text: And Daddy says, 'Well, we had a kit that had a lot of different kinds of fossils in it, and we had an ammonite and a clam, and what we think was maybe a dinosaur bone, and a vertebra, and a coprolite, which is fossilized poop, and um lots of other ones, some of them are kind of hard to identify. transcript.text: And a shark.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Yeah, a shark tooth.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And Daddy said, 'Yes, we have lots of interesting fossils in Isabella's fossil kit.'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: But Seeker,

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: tomorrow you can go to my house to see the rest of my fossils, okay? We can sort them out tomorrow, that's two busy jobs.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Two jobs?

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Two jobs.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: What are the two jobs? Sorting out the fossils and...

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: look at the other batch.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Oh, the... oh, right, there's more fossils to look at. That's true.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: There's another batch of the...

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Well, what should we do right now? Said Seeker.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Take the um the prehistoric animals potion.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Oh, yes. The one that Silver Cat gave gave us as a gift. Well, let's take a sip.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: But it's wrapped in silver shiny paper.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Oh, I'll open up the wrapping, rip, rip, rip, rip, rip. And Seeker opened the wrapping and inside was the new potion made by Silver Cat.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: No, made by Isabella.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Oh right, it was made by Isabella.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Silver Cat can't make potions.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: See, that's a know-how. And Seeker popped open the cork and gave it a sniff. And what did that potion smell like?

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Um, I don't know.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: It smelled like ancient prehistoric creatures. It smelled like animals. Huh, I wonder where they got mastodon fur from to make this potion.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Ding dong.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Oh, who's there? Said Seeker.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Frasgle.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Oh, hi Frasgle.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Red Frasgle.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Oh, Red Frasgle. I haven't seen you in a while. Good morning, what are you up to, Red Frasgle?

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: I want some place to go.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Oh, well, we're about to go visit prehistoric world, would you like to come with us?

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Prehistoric world? What's prehistoric world?

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Well,

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Is it a place I can go?

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Yeah, you could come with us if you take the potion. Me and Jane were just about to go there.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: What's the potion?

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Well, the potion is a magic thing that you mix up out of different ingredients and then you take a sip and say a rhyme and then poof! You're in a different place altogether. And prehistoric world is a place that we haven't been to yet but we think it's a world from a long, long, long, long, long time ago when there were a whole different set of creatures that aren't around today. What do you think, Red Frasgle?

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Aha! And then another Frasgle from behind Red Frasgle, and then Blue Frasgle, Green Frasgle, and then Orange Frasgle.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: They're all coming to my house, said Seeker?

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: And Yellow Frasgle, and Purple Frasgle, then Pink Frasgle, then Silver Frasgle, and Gold Frasgle.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And Seeker said, 'Well, well, well, okay Frasgles, you can all come to prehistoric world but we just have to take turns taking a sip of the potion, and then...' there was a lot of potion sipping 'and then we all have to say the rhyme all together, okay Frasgles? You say the rhyme.'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Slime, slime, slime... slime-kabime, slime-kabime, seem-kabine, slime.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: In Frasgle-ish.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And so Seeker said, 'Slime!' and so did all the Frasgles and then...

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: And Jane said the meow... and Jane said the meow version.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And she said the meow, meow, meow version, yes. And then, poof! They all appeared. And were they all on a big empty plain of grass, or were they in a deep dark forest, or were they high in the mountains?

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Oh, they were next to a T-Rex.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'Oh my goodness!' said Seeker. 'I thought we were going to go see some mastodons or maybe a smilodon or something, or one of those gigantic sloths or something, but this is much scarier! Uh, everybody hide!'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: The T-Rex won't eat you, it's only... 'T-Rex, what do you eat?'

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And the T-Rex made a growling, snorting sound. 'I like meat,' said the T-Rex.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Meat.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And Seeker said, 'Yes, the T-Rex is a carnivore, that means he likes to eat meat. You see all those big, pointy teeth? Those are used to bite things and rip them.'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: But Seeker, um but T-Rex, we are not meat.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'Are you sure about that? You smell delicious.'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: You can't bite us. We are going to go see a giant sloth, actually.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'Oh, well, that red one over there looks delicious, or so does the orange one, and the yellow one... there's so many different colors of furry creatures, I can't decide!'

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And while the T-Rex was confused looking around at all the different Frasgles, what did they do to escape?

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: The Frasgles said, 'Ahhh!'

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And the T-Rex said, 'Oh no! What's that noise? Help!' And the T-Rex lifted his tiny arms over his little ears to block out the crazy sound, and he ran away, stomp, stomp, stomp, stomp, stomp, stomp.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And Seeker said, 'Wow, Frasgles, you saved us all from that giant T-Rex!'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Giant sloth.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Seeker turned around and behind them all while they were distracted by the T-Rex, a creature was creeping up on them. Do you know what was creeping up on them? Very slowly... 'Are you a giant sloth?'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Well, slow down a minute.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: We sloths take things slowly.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Welcome to my sloth burrow. You see that hole in the ground over there? That's where I live. Would you like to come in for a cup of tea?

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: No, we want to see a woolly mammoth next.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Oh,

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Those woolly mammoths move too quickly, always in a hurry. I'm going back home.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And the sloth slowly turned around and began ambling back to its burrow.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: And the sloths, and and the Frasgles made loud sounds to distract the... That means, 'We're coming, woolly mammoth! Slow down!'

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And then there was a rumble, rumble, rumble, rumble, rumble, rumble, and a trumpeting sound that was kind of like an elephant but much deeper, like... 'Who are you?'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Are you a woolly mammoth?

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'Oh, I think so. Are you?'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: No, we're not. We're people.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'Are you sure you're very furry like us?'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Oh, Jane's furry. She's furry but she's no woolly mammoth.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'What is she?'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: A cat. But she's not like a smilodon or anything.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'Smilodon? Where? Those are scary, we better run away! Oh, I don't see any smilodon,' said the mammoth.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Oh, I see a smilodon! Run away, everyone!

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'Run away! Run away!' and the mammoths galloped away, thunder, thunder, thunder, thunder. And Seeker said, 'Wow, we saw so many creatures! I think that's...'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: We only saw two, actually. I mean, we only saw three.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'We saw a T-Rex and a giant sloth and a mastodon,' said Seeker. 'I think that's enough prehistoric adventuring for today.'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Ah, but there's more to see.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: There is?

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Like what?

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: What else should we look for?

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: I don't know. Not something scary next.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Hmm.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Ah! Sabertooth cat! Run away! Run away! Woolly mammoths, run away!

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'That's right,' said Seeker. 'The woolly mammoths were running away because a smilodon was coming.' And you know, smilodons are very dangerous because they're like tigers but really, really, really big, and they might bite us, and so I think we should just take our going home potion right away. transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And all the Frasgles turned and pointed and they said, 'Ahhh!'

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Yeah, smilodon! Everybody take a sip!

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: No, no. What if they just say their loud... their loudest 'Ahhh's, and then he will go away?

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Okay, let's give it a try, said Seeker.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Ahhh!

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And all the Frasgles shouted their loudest 'Ahhh's. And then the smilodon stopped and rolled on its back and showed its belly.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And Seeker said, 'Oh my goodness, that thing may be giant with big teeth and be a fierce predator, but deep down, it's just a cat. Is anybody brave enough to go give it some pets?'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: No. Watch out, you might get clawed or scratched or bitten. We want to take a sip.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Oh, okay.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Of the potion.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'Time to go home,' said Seeker. And everyone took a sip of the going home potion, and that was the end of their prehistoric adventure. And that's the end of Stars and Stories.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: No, I don't want to be the end.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Oh.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Because there's more to our story.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: There is? Well, it's almost time to go to sleep, Isabella. But we can do a little more.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Well, when they got back to Seeker's castle,

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: What did they do?

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Seeker and Jane and all the different rainbow Frasgles, because there was a rainbow of Frasgles with them, looked relieved. And they said, 'Haaah!' Seeker said, 'We made it back safely after seeing all those incredible creatures.' But then, Jane looked down, and Jane was wearing a jacket, and the jacket had a pocket, and she looked down at her pocket. She noticed something unexpected about it.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: What?

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: That something in the pocket was wiggling. Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle, wiggle. And Jane said, 'Meow, what's this?' And Seeker said, 'Oh, I think you've got a passenger. Somebody in prehistoric world must have jumped in your pocket and come home with us.'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: 'Who are you?'

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Oh.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: 'Who are you that you can fit in my pocket?' said Jane.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And then there was a little squeak, squeak, squeak.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: 'Who are you?'

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'Oh my goodness,' said Seeker, as it popped its head out. 'Are you a shrew?'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: 'A shrew-like? Are you a shrew-like, shrew-like? Shrew-like, shrew-like, shrew-like, shrew-like, are you, are you, are you a shrew-like, are you? Shrew-like, shrew-like, are you a shrew-like?'

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And it said, 'No, I'm not a shrew. I'm a shrew-like prehistoric creature and I'd like a snack, please.'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: 'Oh, do you want to live... do you want to live with Isabella? Is it the first time you met her?'

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'It is! And I I might consider it if you have snacks and...'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: 'I am considering that I do have shrew-like snacks.'

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'Like what?'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: 'Like what do you like, shrew-likes?'

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'Bugs.'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: 'Bugs, okay. We've got bugs in our... we've got flies...'

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'Yum!'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: '...flies and ants.'

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'Oh, perfect!'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: 'Flies and ants on order.'

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'Where can I make my nest?'

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'Oh boy.'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: 'Oh boy. Oh, maybe...'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: '...in that dollhouse over there.'

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'Perfect! Thank you!'

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'And now...'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: 'And that can be your house.'

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: '...I'll gobble up some ants and flies.'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: 'That can be your house. I can take you to see anything when you want to.'

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'Okay, but now I've got to take a nap. Bye.'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: 'Take a nap where?'

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'In my house.'

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: 'In that house?'

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: 'Yeah, I'm going to snuggle up right inside.'

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And so the shrew-like prehistoric creature was very happy to have a new home in the doll house with a full belly of bugs, and went to sleep.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Shrew-like, shrew-like, wake up. Wake up. Wake up. There's something you... there's something that will wake you up, so I want you to stay awake. Wake up.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Okay, what is it?

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: There's something that will distract you. It's just this bright light. Do you see this bright light?

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Oh my goodness, I'm trying to sleep.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Yeah, there's this bright light, it makes shadows. And we're going to do shadow puppets. Do you want to learn how to make a heart?

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Yeah, this is how we make a heart, and do shadow puppets.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: That's beautiful shadows, thank you. So now, Dad, can you turn off that bright light for some real light?

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Okay, good night.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: But there's one more thing.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: What's the one more thing?

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: I'm talking to the shrew-like.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: What's the one more thing?

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: It's book time. It will really distract you.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Oh, okay.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: There are sleeping time stories, too, if you want to listen to one of those.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Thank you. And that's the end of Stars and Stories.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: And a very quick...

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Yeah.

characters.name: Seeker
characters.description: A brave dwarven explorer and mediator, he resides in a glowing castle hub—a multiversal dock for skyships anchored within the skyline of New York City. From this urban sanctum, he conducts silver slime experiments and tends to wandering cats amidst a massive library. Frequently swapping between a red coat and a mystical purple cloak, his braided red beard remains his most eccentric tool, capable of catching small fish. A master of fusion, he combines ancient stone-craft with high-velocity mechanics, utilizing a legendary magic ladder to scale the shifting architecture of the realms. Whether brewing portal potions, harvesting floof-berries in Limbo with gemstone goggles, or aiding Buddy the Mouse, this walnut-loving student of the stars remains the hero who orchestrated the daring rescue of the world.

characters.name: Jane
characters.description: Dimetar’s matronly childhood companion is a kindhearted cat and daring ship’s pilot, a friend to Finn, Isabella, and Scratch Cat who navigates the expedition toward Mouse Castle and the road to Cadasori. Her cockpit is a warm sanctuary distinguished by a "love you" sticker and a cabin teeming with whiskered passengers, reflecting the same tenderness she first offered Silver. Though she maintains a bold pace, she is easily swayed by snacks at Seeker’s house or waylaid within the tangled depths of the dark forest. An adventurous spirit with whimsical desires, she currently dreams of a special little hat adorned with rainbow feathers, glitter, and a miniature fishy pond to crown her nautical ensemble.

characters.name: Isabella
characters.description: A towering Dimatar scholar and alchemist of Atsukeeseet, Mama Izzy is a clever kiddo at heart and a steadfast guardian of rooftop gardens and intricate dollhouses. Gifted with the power of flight, she navigates the open heights with aquatic grace, her massive frame often shielded by a special protective metal that glimmers even as she descends into the shadows. As a resourceful quartermaster, she employs red flashlights, gold-laced slimes, and pipe cleaners to mend a Lanternshark’s failing light, yet her generosity remains her hallmark; she freely shares her vast library, brokers homes for dragons, and teaches others to find the resonance in their own voices. Her most profound magic resides in her vast, soft blanket—a sanctuary of ultimate coziness—where she remains a brave, quick-witted protector to all who honor her singular request for absolute silence.

characters.name: Silver Cat
characters.description: A cat who receives a medium-sized, sparkly silver cardboard hat from Hattie.

characters.name: Red Frasgle
characters.description: One of the many colorful, furry Frasgle creatures who join the expedition to the prehistoric world.

characters.name: T-Rex
characters.description: A fierce meat-eating dinosaur in the prehistoric world who is easily startled by the loud noises of the Frasgles.

characters.name: Giant sloth
characters.description: A slow-moving prehistoric creature who lives in a burrow and enjoys drinking tea.

characters.name: Woolly mammoth
characters.description: A giant prehistoric elephant-like creature that is easily frightened by smilodons.

characters.name: Smilodon
characters.description: A fierce, giant saber-toothed cat who terrifies mammoths but ultimately loves being belly-rubbed like a normal cat.

characters.name: Shrew-like
characters.description: A tiny shrew-like prehistoric creature who hitches a ride back in Jane's pocket and moves into Isabella's dollhouse.

places.name: Prehistoric world
places.description: An ancient world filled with dinosaurs, giant sloths, woolly mammoths, and smilodons.

places.name: Seeker's Castle
places.description: Behind an unassuming facade and a solitary doorbell lies Seeker’s home, a sprawling magical fortress that serves as a vital sanctuary for weary legends. The interior expands into a labyrinthine refuge where an expansive library of mystical books towers beside a potion closet that acts as the true gateway to adventure. This fortress is a hub for calls to action and well-earned rest, where Wobbly Whiskers waits to greet the Seeker and Buddy the Mouse—though the warmth of their homecoming is inevitably punctuated by his latest sticky mess upon the rug.

places.name: Isabella's House
places.description: A home on Cornell Street with a basement containing bins of storybooks.

places.name: Sloth's burrow
places.description: A hole in the ground where the giant sloth resides and invites guests in for tea.

places.name: Isabella's dollhouse
places.description: A perfect cozy nesting spot that Isabella offers as a new home for the tiny shrew-like creature.
